contracts.blurb: Planners book your camera crews for every big Saturday owambe.
A regional TV station licenses your family comedies for weekend nights.
Your films play on Ghanaian screens the month after Lagos.
A South African platform takes your back catalogue, title by title.
Weekend screenings of your films for families far from home.
Festival-style showings of your best films across Canada.

belt.name: Footage Trolley
belt.blurb: Rolls drives and memory cards from the set and booth to the edit and mix stations.

auto.name: Auto Render Farm
auto.blurb: Edits and mixes on its own, so stations keep making while staff rest.

pack.name: Koko Dispatch Drone Bay
pack.blurb: Flies finished films, songs and ticket rolls from every station to the counter.

milestones.title: Second Studio
milestones.blurb: Ibadan opens. Same gold reel on the door.

milestones.title: Five Studios
milestones.blurb: Couples across Lagos and Ogun ask for Koko Reel by name.

milestones.title: Ten Edit Suites
milestones.blurb: Ten towns, ten edit suites, one gold reel.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: Studios in the North, East and South-South, each with its own manager.

milestones.title: Film School
milestones.blurb: Koko Reel trains young editors and sound engineers for free on Saturdays.

milestones.title: Across Africa
milestones.blurb: Accra, Nairobi and Johannesburg studios open with local crews.

milestones.title: Golden Reel Awards
milestones.blurb: A night for every crew member who made the films.

milestones.title: World Premiere Week
milestones.blurb: Lagos, London, Toronto and Atlanta in one week. Mama Okoye sits in front.

staff: Memory cards from the owambe, coming!
Light is back, save your project!
Colour grade done for reel two.
Crew lunch is on the way.
customer: Please make my wedding video sweet.
Can you mix my song by Friday?
Is the new film showing here?
My mother cried at the highlights reel!
Do you have a booth free tonight?
We want the licence for Ghana.
Your sound engineer is a genius.
manager: Crew is paid for this week, sir.
Cinema is half full tonight. Popcorn is selling.
night: Pay your crew first, then yourself.
One camcorder and a mattress. Look at us now.
A good script saves money on set.
Old songs still pay while I sleep.
Fair splits keep artists at home.

events.name: Song Goes Viral
events.text: A dance challenge picks up your new song. More fans come today and plays double.

events.name: Generator Cough
events.text: Light is gone and the gen is coughing. Diesel costs extra today.

events.name: Festival Selection
events.text: Your film is picked for a big festival. Buyers pay 25% more today.

events.name: Rain on Set
events.text: Heavy rain floods the set yard. Footage comes in slowly today.

events.name: Sold-Out Weekend
events.text: Salary week plus a public holiday. Queues are twice as long.

events.name: Leaked Copy
events.text: A pirate copy is online. You report it and tighten drive security. Fewer buyers today.

events.name: Brand Wants Your Star
events.text: A clean brand deal lands for your artist. You share the fee fairly.

events.name: Corrupted Drive
events.text: One footage drive refuses to open. You restore it from backup, slowly.

mech.name: Hand carry
mech.how: Memory cards and drives carried in a camera bag from set to edit desk

mech.name: Footage trolley
mech.how: Yellow flight-case cart with blinking drive bays rolls between the rooms

mech.name: Studio keke
mech.how: Tricycle with padded crates brings props and drives from the set yard

mech.name: Production van
mech.how: Black van with the gold reel logo parks at the studio, crew unload drives

mech.name: Auto render farm
mech.how: Glass server cabinet with green lights edits and mixes on its own

mech.name: Drone bay
mech.how: Three white drones carry gold film cans from every station to the counter

storyNote: Story follows plan2/media.json. All film, song and artist names are invented. Piracy and unpaid crew appear only as problems to fix.
